question: Which article of the Indian constitution talks about Oath or affirmation by the President?
solution:
The correct answer is __Article 60.__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 60: Oath or affirmation by the president.
 
• The Oath or affirmation is given to the President by the Chief Justice of India and in his absence by the Senior-most judge of the Supreme Court.
 
• Oath or Affirmation by the President__:- Before entering his office, the President has to make and subscribe to an oath or affirmation. In his oath, the President swears:
 __
 
• To faithfully execute the office.
 
• To preserve, protect and defend the Constitution and law.
 
• To devote himself to the service and well-being of the people of India.
